final: WITH inv_rows AS (SELECT c.gender AS gender FROM Invoices i JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id), gcounts AS (SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM inv_rows GROUP BY gender), avg_row AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM gcounts WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT g.gender, g.cnt, a.avg_cnt FROM gcounts g JOIN avg_row a ON a.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL WHERE g.cnt > a.avg_cnt) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_kept_count, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess_over_overall_avg FROM kept
